description: Model A: baseline U-Net, noisy linear RGB only -> clean linear RGB. No photon level / P / metadata input.
inputs: noisy linear-light RGB (counts / P), 3 channels, unclipped
targets: clean linear-light RGB from data/v2/reference (sRGB16 -> linear), 3 channels
loss: masked MSE in linear light (FOV mask)
augmentation: random dihedral transform (8: flips + 90-degree rotations), identical on input/target/mask; no intensity or noise augmentation
training_levels: all six, sampled uniformly (each (image, level) sample once per pass)
noisy_data: fixed stored realization 0 from data/v2/photon_sim (no on-the-fly resampling)
